genie_demo.contact_centre.gold_forecast_.comment: 30-day call volume forecast — stub with weekly seasonality + trend (ai_forecast not yet available on serverless notebook compute)

columns.comment: Forecast date (DATE).

columns.name: y_hat
columns.comment: Point forecast — predicted call volume for the day.

columns.comment: Lower bound of the forecast confidence interval (~95% CI).

genie_demo.contact_centre.gold_kpi_summa.comment: Pre-aggregated KPI scan target — calls grouped by (date, week, site, region, channel, topic, queue, tenure_bucket). Sources mv_calls and the dashboard summary_calls dataset. Re-aggregate measures via SUM/SUM ratios so weighting stays correct.

columns.name: date
columns.comment: Calendar date (DATE).

columns.name: week
columns.comment: Monday-anchored week truncation (TIMESTAMP).

columns.name: site_id
columns.comment: Site identifier — Athens, Birmingham, Cambridge, Dublin, Manchester, Toledo.

columns.name: region
columns.comment: Region of the site — EMEA / AMER / APAC.

columns.name: channel
columns.comment: voice, chat, or email.

columns.name: topic
columns.comment: Call topic.

columns.name: queue
columns.comment: Inbound queue identifier.

columns.name: tenure_bucket
columns.comment: new / junior / tenured.

columns.name: calls
columns.comment: Number of calls in this group. Use SUM(calls) for total volume.

columns.name: handle_time_sum
columns.comment: Sum of handle_time_sec. Compute AHT as SUM(handle_time_sum) / SUM(calls).

columns.name: wait_time_sum
columns.comment: Sum of wait_time_sec across all channels.

columns.name: wait_time_vc_sum
columns.comment: Sum of wait_time_voice_chat_sec (voice + chat only). Pair with wait_time_vc_count to compute ASA.

columns.name: wait_time_vc_count
columns.comment: Count of voice/chat calls in the group. Use SUM(wait_time_vc_sum)/SUM(wait_time_vc_count) for ASA.

columns.name: sla_sum
columns.comment: Sum of meets_sla flag. Compute SLA % as SUM(sla_sum)/SUM(calls).

columns.name: abandon_sum
columns.comment: Sum of is_abandoned flag. Compute abandon rate as SUM(abandon_sum)/SUM(calls).

columns.name: negative_sum
columns.comment: Sum of is_negative flag. Compute negative share as SUM(negative_sum)/SUM(calls).

columns.name: csat_sum
columns.comment: Sum of csat_score (excludes NULLs). Pair with csat_count to compute CSAT.

columns.name: csat_count
columns.comment: Count of calls with non-null csat_score. Use SUM(csat_sum)/SUM(csat_count) for CSAT average.

columns.name: sentiment_sum
columns.comment: Sum of sentiment_score. Compute avg sentiment as SUM(sentiment_sum)/SUM(calls).

genie_demo.contact_centre.mv_calls.comment: Meridian Customer Operations KPI semantic layer. One source of truth for SLA, ASA, AHT, abandon, CSAT, sentiment, and call volume — same definitions the dashboard reads. Sources gold_kpi_summary for fast KPI scans. For agent-level KPIs use silver_calls_wide directly. Use MEASURE() to retrieve any measure.

columns.name: date
columns.comment: Calendar date (DATE).

columns.name: week
columns.comment: Monday-anchored week truncation (TIMESTAMP). Use for weekly aggregates.

columns.name: channel
columns.comment: voice, chat, or email.

columns.name: queue
columns.comment: Inbound queue identifier (queue_01 .. queue_08).

columns.name: topic
columns.comment: Call topic — Billing, Order Status, Account Access, Technical Issue, Cancellation, General Enquiry.

columns.name: site_id
columns.comment: Site that handled the call: Athens, Birmingham, Cambridge, Dublin, Manchester, Toledo.

columns.name: region
columns.comment: Region of the site: EMEA / AMER / APAC.

columns.name: tenure_bucket
columns.comment: "new" (≤90 days), "junior" (≤365 days), or "tenured" (>365 days).

columns.name: total_calls
columns.comment: Total calls (handled + abandoned).

columns.name: handled_calls
columns.comment: Calls answered (excludes abandoned).

columns.name: abandon_rate
columns.comment: Share of calls abandoned before answer (0.0 - 1.0). Industry target ≤5%.

columns.name: sla_pct
columns.comment: Service-level percentage. Channel-aware threshold: voice ≤20s, chat ≤60s, email ≤24h. Abandoned counts as missed SLA. Industry target ≥80%.

columns.name: avg_handle_sec
columns.comment: Average handle time in seconds (AHT). Industry target ≤300s.

columns.name: avg_wait_voice_chat_sec
columns.comment: Average speed of answer (ASA) for voice + chat in seconds. Email excluded. Industry target ≤30s.

columns.name: csat
columns.comment: Average customer satisfaction (1-5 scale). Industry target ≥4.0. Excludes the ~30% of calls with no survey response.

columns.name: avg_sentiment
columns.comment: Average sentiment score in [-1, 1].

columns.name: negative_share
columns.comment: Share of calls with sentiment_score < -0.2.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Unique agent identifier

columns.name: site_id
columns.comment: FK → silver_sites.site_id

columns.name: team
columns.comment: Team name: Alpha / Bravo / Charlie / Delta

columns.name: hire_date
columns.comment: Date the agent was hired

columns.name: full_time
columns.comment: TRUE if full-time employee

columns.name: tenure_days
columns.comment: Days since hire_date

columns.name: full_name
columns.comment: Agent display name — surfaced in dashboards and Genie

genie_demo.contact_centre.silver_calls_w.comment: Wide call grain — calls × agents × sites with pre-baked SLA / abandon / negative flags and a voice/chat-only wait column. Source for the dashboard wide_calls dataset and the mv_calls metric view. One row per call.

columns.name: call_id
columns.comment: Unique call identifier (FK → gold_calls_enriched.call_id).

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: Call start timestamp.

columns.name: ended_at
columns.comment: Call end timestamp.

columns.name: date
columns.comment: Calendar date the call started — DATE type, use for daily aggregates.

columns.name: week
columns.comment: Monday-anchored week truncation of started_at — TIMESTAMP, use for weekly aggregates.

columns.name: channel
columns.comment: voice, chat, or email.

columns.name: queue
columns.comment: Inbound queue identifier — queue_01 through queue_08.

columns.name: topic
columns.comment: Call topic: Billing, Order Status, Account Access, Technical Issue, Cancellation, General Enquiry.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Agent that handled the call (FK → silver_agents.agent_id).

columns.name: agent_name
columns.comment: Agent display name — denormalised from silver_agents.full_name for Genie usability.

columns.name: team
columns.comment: Agent team: Alpha / Bravo / Charlie / Delta.

columns.name: hire_date
columns.comment: Date the agent was hired.

columns.name: full_time
columns.comment: TRUE if the agent is full-time.

columns.name: tenure_days
columns.comment: Days since hire_date as of the call.

columns.name: tenure_bucket
columns.comment: "new" (<=90 days), "junior" (<=365 days), or "tenured" (>365 days). Use this for new-hire-vs-tenured comparisons.

columns.name: site_id
columns.comment: Site that handled the call: Athens, Birmingham, Cambridge, Dublin, Manchester, Toledo.

columns.name: region
columns.comment: Region of the site: EMEA / AMER / APAC.

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: IANA timezone of the site.

columns.name: site_capacity
columns.comment: Max concurrent agents the site is provisioned for.

columns.name: handle_time_sec
columns.comment: Handle time (seconds) — agent talk/work time. Aka AHT.

columns.name: handle_time_min
columns.comment: Handle time in minutes (handle_time_sec / 60).

columns.name: wait_time_sec
columns.comment: Customer wait time before the call was answered, in seconds. Includes email response times (up to 24h).

columns.name: wait_time_min
columns.comment: Wait time in minutes (wait_time_sec / 60).

columns.name: wait_time_voice_chat_sec
columns.comment: Wait time for voice/chat calls only — NULL for email. Use this for ASA (avg speed of answer) so email response times do not skew the average.

columns.name: abandoned
columns.comment: TRUE if the call was abandoned before being answered.

columns.name: csat_score
columns.comment: Customer satisfaction 1-5. NULL for ~30% of calls (no survey response).

columns.name: sentiment_score
columns.comment: Seeded sentiment score in [-1, 1]. <-0.2 is negative.

columns.name: ai_summary
columns.comment: AI-generated call summary (ai_summarize) — populated only on the bottom 500 calls by sentiment. NULL otherwise.

columns.name: ai_sentiment_label
columns.comment: AI sentiment label (ai_analyze_sentiment) — populated on the same bottom-500 slice as ai_summary. NULL otherwise.

columns.name: meets_sla
columns.comment: Channel-aware SLA flag (0.0 / 1.0). Voice <=20s, chat <=60s, email <=24h, abandoned counts as 0. Use AVG(meets_sla) for SLA %.

columns.name: is_abandoned
columns.comment: Numeric form of abandoned (0.0 / 1.0). Use AVG(is_abandoned) for abandon rate.

columns.name: is_negative
columns.comment: Numeric flag: 1.0 if sentiment_score < -0.2, else 0.0. Use AVG(is_negative) for negative-call share.

columns.name: site_id
columns.comment: Unique site identifier, e.g. Birmingham

columns.name: region
columns.comment: Geographic region: EMEA / AMER / APAC

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: IANA timezone

columns.name: capacity
columns.comment: Max concurrent agents supported at this site
